basis: Independent teaching assumptions; no manufacturer measurements or experimental calibration

spatial_extension.method: Conservative 2D cell-centered finite volume, uniform temperature through thickness
spatial_extension.source_interpretation: 80 percent of 2 W inside the specified patch, 20 percent spread over the full cell volume; 2 W total, not an extra 2 W
spatial_extension.boundary_interpretation: Same effective coefficient on both broad faces and four edges. Edge face loss includes half-cell conduction resistance. No enclosure or inter-component heat transfer.
spatial_extension.conductivity_basis: New illustrative in-plane conductivities used only for the spatial extension; not used or fitted in the 0D comparison
